home_portal.desc: Streamlined KYC verification and processing for Kisan Credit Card applications. Secure, efficient, and digitally empowering Indian agriculture.
home_portal.about_desc: KYC means 'Know Your Customer' — an effective process for institutions to confirm and verify the authenticity of a customer. All customers are required to submit KYC documentation before investing in various instruments. As mandated by the RBI, all financial institutions must complete the KYC process for every customer before authorizing any financial transactions. Whether through online or offline channels, KYC is a simple one-time process that ensures security and compliance.
home_portal.importance_desc: KYC is essential for any financial transaction. After verification, the customer provides the financial institution with information about their identity, address, and financial history. This enables banks to verify that investments are legitimate and not linked to any money-laundering activities. KYC also helps prevent identity theft, financial fraud, and terrorist financing, ensuring a safer ecosystem for all stakeholders.
